text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
This is simply incredible! The winner<n>of the first
race in the Classic Triple<n>Crown series is...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: (I... didn't lose. I didn't lose, and<n>yet...)
(Urk!)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(I still feel so overwhelmed by the<n>intensity in her
voice!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Gasp... Wheeze... Ngah! I'll win thenext one... even if it kills me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Don't think I've forgotten you, Ticket.<n>I'll beat you
too.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: You two are so amazing...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Buuut! Didja forget? The next race<n>up's the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Which means I'll be winning!Becoming the Derby Champion is mydream...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: And no one's getting in the way of it!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: DEEERRRBBBYYY! RAAAAAGH!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Tch... What's she getting all fired up<n>for after
losing?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Not that I can really talk...

Despite her noteworthy victory, Biwa<n>Hayahide
looks troubled.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh, no. Everything's fine.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'm not scared about anything!
choice_data_list: Scared? Who said anything about being scared?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Uh... Not me! Because I'm not! We're<n>progressing
just fine!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
However... we overlooked something,<n>which is why
I made that<n>miscalculation about Taishin...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ticket is tenacious and persists at full<n>speed until
the very end... And the<n>ferocity of Taishin's pursuit
is<n>unparalleled.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Both of them are first-class<n>competitors in their own
right.<n>They're incredible.

I'm sure Biwa Hayahide has<n>analyzed her
opponents thoroughly,<n>so I'm puzzled as to why
she's still<n>so apprehensive.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
We don't have much time left until<n>the Derby. If
we're going to make<n>revisions to our calculations,
we need<n>to hurry.

The next stop on our journey<n>together is the
second race of the<n>Classic Triple Crown tour—the
Japanese Derby.

But hearing such urgency in her voice<n>makes me
worry that something in<n>her is beginning to crack.
